task.title: Logging into Quay through the Hybrid Cloud Console
task.shortdesc: To sign in to Quay on the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console, you can use your Red Hat account. You are redirected to the Quay repository landing page after authentication.

ul.li: You have created a Red Hat account and a Quay.io account. For more information, see "Creating a Quay.io account".

step.cmd: Navigate to Quay on the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console and log in using your Red Hat account. You are redirected to the Quay repository landing page:

image.alt: Quay on the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console
